title: Diagnosis and plan
summary: Review and confirm the suggested stability, 2017 classification, risk and plan.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart with probing is the guide (a screening never is).

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.details: Everything is worked out by the system as a suggestion; the doctor reviews and confirms it.

steps.title: How it is today
steps.details: Stable, stable with inflammation or unstable, with the list that supports it.

steps.title: Data not from the probing
steps.details: Teeth lost to periodontitis, X-ray bone loss, age, smoking and diabetes: they define stage IV and the grade.

steps.title: 2017 classification
steps.details: Case, stage (how severe), extent (where) and grade (how fast), with the reason. They can be changed; what is changed is marked.

steps.title: Risk
steps.details: Six Lang & Tonetti parameters; the risk suggests how many months between check-ups.

steps.title: Implants
steps.details: In “implants only”: healthy, mucositis or peri-implantitis for each implant.

steps.title: Plan by steps
steps.details: Hygiene, reinstrumentation per tooth, re-evaluation and maintenance, each Today or Later.

steps.title: Confirm diagnosis
steps.details: With probing complete, tap it to put the diagnosis in the clinical record. If you change something afterwards, it has to be confirmed again.
